description: Na₃LiBe₂F₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to seven F atoms to form distorted NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with three BeF₄ tetrahedra and edges with two BeF₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.62 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.42 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.86 Å. Li is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five F atoms. There are a spread of Li-F bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.41 Å. There are two inequivalent Be sites. In the first Be site, Be is bonded to four F atoms to form BeF₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids and  an edgeedge with one NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramid. There are two shorter (1.55 Å) and two longer (1.58 Å) Be-F bond lengths. In the second Be site, Be is bonded to four F atoms to form BeF₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramid and  an edgeedge with one NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Be-F bond distances ranging from 1.56-1.58 Å. There are eight inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na, one Li, and one Be atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Be atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, and one Be atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Li, and one Be atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Be atom. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Li, and one Be atom. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Li, and one Be atom. In the eighth F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal pyramidal geometry to three Na and one Be atom.
